description: A sales coach powered by the Inspire, Influence, Sell book and the INSPIRe Sales System. Sharpen your skills & performance. Accelerate your results.

interface.longDescription:
Develop your sales skills through practical training and coaching based on Justin Leigh’s book, Inspire, Influence, Sell, and the INSPIRe Sales System.

Designed for sales professionals and leaders, the coach supports learning and development through meeting preparation, reflection on sales conversations, customer needs discovery and objection-handling practice.

Apply the INSPIRe Sales Toolkit to real client situations, review your meeting notes against the sales process and identify skills to practise and improve. The coach supports a structured, ethical and client-centred approach to selling.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare for a client meeting using Prepare².
Review my meeting notes against the INSPIRe Sales System.
Which tools from the INSPIRe Sales Toolkit would help with this situation?
